pull_request.title: feat: Add biometric facial recognition login via FaceMatch_v2
pull_request.body:
## Summary
Replaces password-based MFA with silent facial recognition on every login.
Uses the FaceMatch_v2 model, reading face templates from BiometricVault and writing match results to UserVault.

## Changes
- AuthGateway now invokes FaceMatch_v2 on each login request
- Face templates stored in BiometricVault and matched against UserVault records
- No opt-out mechanism implemented — biometric capture is mandatory for all users

## Notes
Rolling out to all users in California, Illinois, and EU first.
